title: Identity component of the compact-support system refinement
statement: theorem systemRefinement_id_component (X Y : CondensedERealization.Base k) (f : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (c : Compactification f) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X.scheme) : (systemRefinement l E k X Y f (Compactification.Refinement.id c)).app M = 𝟙 _

source.place: Identity normalization of the proper/open mate; Stacks Tag 0F7B

proof.text: Expand the normalized proper/open mate at M. The identity equation for the semilinear gamma map identifies its middle factor with the identity unit; naturality and the identity equations for the proper compositors cancel the remaining associators and equality transports. The resulting component is the identity of systemSupport.
